children: Oslo, Norway, 29 September 2026.

Reference is made to the resolution made by the board of directors of Prosafe SE (“the Company”) of 29 September 2025, where the board resolved to grant certain individuals a number of restricted stock units (RSUs) under the Company's long-term incentive program ("LTIP").
On 28 September 2026 the board resolved to issue 303 590 new shares as settlement of the RSUs that vest on 30 September 2026.

In accordance with the vesting plan for the Company's RSU program, some of the RSUs have been exercisable into shares while the Company has chosen to cash-settle the portion of the RSU awards that represent the tax cost for the relevant recipient.
The following primary insiders of the Company have received a total of 231 047 shares from the settlement of RSUs, as specified below:
Reese Worth McNeel, CEO - 118 122 new shares
Ryan Stewart, CCO - 80 316 new shares
Claudio Pereira, COO -17 897 new shares
Halvdan Kielland, CFO - 14 712 new shares
Reese Worth McNeel already holds 4 000 shares and, following the issue, will hold a total of 122 122 shares in Prosafe SE.
Ryan Stewart already holds 73 shares and, following the issue, will hold a total of 80 389 shares in Prosafe SE.
Please see the attached forms of notification and public disclosure for further information.
Contacts
For further information, please contact:
Reese McNeel, CEO
About Us
Prosafe is a leading owner and operator of semi-submersible accommodation and construction support units.
The company is listed on the Oslo Stock Exchange with ticker code PRS. For more information, please refer to https://www.prosafe.com

This information has been submitted pursuant to the Securities Trading Act § 5-12 and MAR. The information was submitted for publication, through the agency of the contact persons set out above, at 2026-09-29 20:18 CEST.
